title: Installing Skills with pi
description: Three pi install commands that add skills from npm or a Git host, with a flag that keeps the install project-local.

steps.description: `pi install` adds extensions and skills from a package registry or a Git host.
Line 1 installs an npm package; line 2 installs from GitHub. Both go to your home directory by default.
The `-l` flag scopes the install to the current project instead of your home directory.

steps.question: Which flag scopes an install to the current project?
